AR.why: The receptor is the target whether or not it is altered. Alterations appear after treatment, not before it.

structure.title: Crystal structure of human androgen receptor ligand binding domain in complex with testosterone

FOLH1.why: PSMA is an address for a radioactive payload, not a driver. Selection is by PET imaging, not by sequencing.

PARP1.why: Not altered here and drugged anyway: PARP inhibition only works once homologous recombination is already lost.

structure.title: Structure of the catalytic domain of PARP1 in complex with olaparib

BRCA1.why: As BRCA2, and rarer in prostate.

structure.title: Crystal structure of the BRCT repeat region from the breast cancer associated protein, BRCA1

BRCA2.why: A deleterious alteration selects a PARP inhibitor, and is also the strongest inherited risk factor for this cancer.

domains.name: Required for stimulation of POLH DNA polymerization activity

ATM.why: Counted in the HRR panel that selects PARP inhibitors, on weaker evidence than BRCA2.

CDK12.why: Biallelic loss defines an immunologically distinct group; part of the HRR panel.

CHEK2.why: HRR panel gene; a moderate-penetrance risk allele as well.

domains.name: DNA-binding (with the preference D loop > dsDNA > ssDNA)
Required for its oligomerization and is important for its focal concentration at DNA damage sites
ChAM (Chromatin-association motif); required for chromatin association, mediates nucleosome association
Required for interaction with POLH and POLH DNA synthesis stimulation
Interaction with RAD51, BRCA2 and POLH

PTEN.why: Deletion selects capivasertib with abiraterone. The gene itself cannot be restored; what it releases can be blocked.

uniprot.protein: Phosphatidylinositol 3,4,5-trisphosphate 3-phosphatase and dual-specificity protein phosphatase PTEN

structure.title: Crystal Structure of the PTEN Tumor Suppressor

AKT1.why: Rarely mutated here. The dependency comes from PTEN loss upstream, which is what the biomarker actually measures.

structure.title: PKB alpha in complex with AZD5363
Co-crystal Structures of the Lipid Kinase PI3K alpha with Pan and Isoform Selective Inhibitors

TP53.why: The most altered gene in advanced disease and the one with nothing aimed at it.

structure.title: TUMOR SUPPRESSOR P53 COMPLEXED WITH DNA

RB1.why: Undruggable, and the loudest warning of lineage change.

domains.name: Domain C; mediates interaction with E4F1

structure.title: RB POCKET BOUND TO E7 LXCXE MOTIF

MYC.why: Amplified in a quarter of castration-resistant tumours; a protein-protein interface rather than a pocket.

structure.title: Crystal structure of Myc-Max recognizing DNA

SPOP.why: Defines a molecular class and selects nothing. Included because what it predicts is interesting, not because it is druggable.

FOXA1.why: Reshapes where the androgen receptor can bind rather than how much of it there is.

STEAP1.why: A surface antigen for a T-cell engager; expression is the whole selection criterion.

CYP17A1.why: Not a cancer gene. Abiraterone blocks the enzyme that makes androgens, starving the receptor rather than blocking it.

MSH2.why: Mismatch-repair loss selects pembrolizumab, tissue-agnostically. Rare in prostate.

ERG.why: The commonest event in the disease and not a target: a fusion product with no drug against it.

labels_summary.source: openFDA drug label API (US FDA Structured Product Labeling)
labels_summary.licence: openFDA is a US federal government resource; label content is publicly available regulatory text
labels_summary.caveat: Excerpts of US FDA labels, not a safety summary and not advice. An agent without a label here is one openFDA returned no US label for: an investigational agent has none yet, and an approved one may be approved outside the US or missed by the search. Neither means it has no side effects.
